guide.title: How to use Ehsbha
guide.subtitle: A short, friendly tour — from zero to knowing your real profit per kilometer.

guide.tipsSubtitle: The cleaner your inputs, the smarter your insights.

tips.daily: Log trips daily — memory fades and weekly batches lose accuracy.
tips.received: Always enter "Received" to auto-calc commission correctly.
tips.kmBoth: Track both total + paid km — empty km drives true cost analysis.
tips.expenses: Add fuel + recurring expenses (rent, insurance) for true net profit.
tips.vehicleCosts: Configure vehicle costs (Vehicle health → Configure) — without them, profit/km is overstated.
tips.wellness: Use Wellness for optional reminders and your daily checklist.
tips.goals: Set a realistic monthly goal — the planner suggests daily targets to hit it.

guide.faqSubtitle: Tap a question to see the answer.

profit.a: Net = Gross + Tips − Commission − Tolls − Parking − Fuel cost (from km × your vehicle's km/L × current price) − Other expenses for the day.

score.a: Version 2 compares your results with your own previous recorded days. It does not assess driving safety, fatigue, sleep, or health. The overall indicator uses efficiency 7/15, profit 5/15, and work-time variation 3/15. These product weights are not an industry benchmark.

commission.q: Do I have to type the commission for every trip?
commission.a: No. Enter "Received after fees" and commission is calculated as Gross − Received. Or leave it auto and we use your app's default %.

vehicleCost.a: It's fuel + oil + tires + brakes + (battery, chain for bikes) + monthly overhead, divided by the km those parts last. Configure costs once and it's accurate forever.

offline.q: Can I use Ehsbha without internet?
offline.a: Yes. It's a Progressive Web App — install it from the browser menu (or the install banner), and most pages work offline.

data.q: Is my data shared with my apps (Uber, inDrive…)?
data.a: No. Your data stays in Ehsbha. We don't have an integration with any ride-share platform — you enter trips yourself.

language.a: Yes — tap the AR/EN toggle in the top bar, or change it from Settings → Appearance.

delete.q: How do I delete a trip or expense?
delete.a: Open the entry, tap the red Delete button, and confirm. Aggregates and scores update automatically.

guide.ctaFooter: Ready? Log your first trip and watch the numbers light up.

support.introBody: Ehsbha gets better with your feedback. Bug reports, feature requests, and ideas are all welcome.

categoryHints.FEATURE_REQUEST: A new tool or capability you'd love
categoryHints.QUESTION: Ask us anything

field.subject: Subject
field.bodyPlaceholder: What happened, what you expected, and any steps to reproduce.

errors.subjectShort: Subject must be at least 3 characters
errors.bodyShort: Tell us a bit more — at least 10 characters

support.trustNoteBody: Every report and idea goes directly to the team.

trust.growingBody: We're continuously improving — new tools, sharper insights, and ideas straight from drivers like you. Your feedback shapes the next release.

errors.DAILY_DISTANCE_CONFLICT: The recorded daily distance is less than the trips' paid distance. Correct the daily distance or trip distances, then save again.
errors.USER_NOT_FOUND: No account is registered with this phone number
errors.NO_EMAIL_ON_FILE: No recovery email is linked to this account — contact support to reset
errors.RESET_EXPIRED: No active reset request — request a new code
errors.RESET_LOCKED: Too many wrong attempts — request a new code
errors.REVIEW_EXISTS: You already have a review — edit it instead
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do that
errors.routeTitle: Something went wrong loading this page
errors.routeBody: We couldn't load this part of the app. Check your connection, then try again.
errors.notFoundBody: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has been moved.
errors.TRIP_FINANCIAL_EVIDENCE_INVALID: Enter take-home income, or enough fare and commission details to calculate it. Check that the amounts and tips agree.
errors.REPORTING_CALENDAR_PENDING: Reports are being rebuilt for Cairo calendar dates. Retry after the reporting update finishes.
errors.EXPENSE_VERSION_CONFLICT: This expense changed after you opened it. Your entries have not overwritten the newer record. Review the latest saved version. If a device draft still contains the older version, keep any notes you need and discard that draft before starting a new correction.
errors.EXPENSE_LINK_CONFLICT: The trip fee and expense do not match, or that fee is already linked. Review the amount, vehicle and category. Unlink an existing payment before changing its financial details.
errors.MAINTENANCE_LINK_CONFLICT: The expense and service must describe the same payment: Other category, matching cost and compatible vehicle, with one active service link. Open Maintenance to unlink it before changing these details.
errors.MAINTENANCE_VERSION_CONFLICT: This service changed elsewhere. Review the latest saved version. If a device draft still contains the older version, keep any notes you need and discard that draft before starting a new correction.
errors.REPORTING_PROJECTION_PENDING: Financial reports are being rebuilt from recorded costs. Retry shortly.
errors.FUEL_LINK_CONFLICT: This expense is already linked or no longer matches. Review its vehicle, category and amount before linking.
errors.FUEL_VERSION_CONFLICT: This fuel record changed. Review the latest saved version. If a device draft still contains the older version, keep any notes you need and discard that draft before starting a new correction.
errors.VEHICLE_ODOMETER_CONFLICT: The mileage changed while this form was open. Close the form and reload the vehicle before confirming your reading.
errors.TRIP_VERSION_CONFLICT: This trip changed since you opened it. Your draft is kept. Review the latest trip, then discard this draft and re-enter the changes you still want.
errors.SESSION_ALREADY_OPEN: A work session is already open. Review it and end it before starting another.
errors.SESSION_ALREADY_ENDED: This work session was ended by another action. Refresh to review the saved end time.
errors.SESSION_VERSION_CONFLICT: This session changed elsewhere. Review the current record and discard the old draft before entering a new correction.
errors.SESSION_STATE_CONFLICT: This action no longer matches the session state. Review the current record before trying again.
errors.NOTIFICATION_PREFERENCES_CONFLICT: Delivery settings changed elsewhere. Review the saved settings and discard this old draft before making a new change.
errors.DIGEST_INSUFFICIENT_DATA: There is not enough recorded history or an active monthly goal for a digest yet. Add records or a goal, then retry.
errors.REPORT_PERIOD_NOT_COMPLETE: This period is still in progress in Cairo. Choose a completed week or month.
errors.REPORT_VERSION_CONFLICT: A newer report version exists. Open it and discard the old revision draft before saving another version.
errors.REPORT_PREFERENCES_CONFLICT: Report delivery settings changed elsewhere. Review the saved settings and discard this old draft before changing them.

time.cairo: All trip and expense times use Cairo time, including daylight saving changes.
time.invalid: Enter a valid Cairo time. If the clock repeats, choose before or after the clock change.
time.repeated: This time occurs twice when the clock goes back.
time.intervalTooLong: A recorded trip cannot be longer than seven days.
time.reportBasis: Calendar dates and working hours follow Cairo time.
time.reportFailed: The report could not load. Check your connection and retry; your saved records are retained.

fuel.title: Fuel & charging
fuel.subtitle: Record what you paid. Measure consumption only when the records support it.
fuel.vehiclesFailed: Vehicles could not load. Check your connection and retry.
fuel.noVehicles: Add a vehicle to record fuel or charging.
fuel.loadFailed: Fuel purchases could not load. Retry to see the records and total.
fuel.empty: No purchases for this vehicle and month.
fuel.total: All recorded purchases in this period
fuel.paymentBasis: The total lists purchase amounts, including purchases linked to expenses. In net income, a linked active expense counts once on its expense date. If that expense is deleted, an active purchase counts on its purchase date.
fuel.restoreHint: Restore this purchase to active records and recalculate its costs and mileage.
fuel.deleteHint: Remove this purchase from active records and recalculate its costs and mileage. Its correction history is retained and you can restore it.
fuel.historyHint: Versions show recorded financial and mileage changes. Notes are excluded. Older purchases may have no history before this feature was introduced.
fuel.historyFailed: Correction history could not load. Retry to review changes.
fuel.noHistory: No correction history is available for this purchase.

field.fullTank: The tank was full after this purchase
field.coverage: Fills since the previous full tank

fuel.entryHint: Vehicle, date and actual payment are enough. Enter zero only for a genuinely free purchase.
fuel.optionalHint: Leave unknown quantity, unit price or mileage blank. Quantity uses the unit shown above. Enter the actual odometer at this purchase, not estimated trip distance.
fuel.amountDifference: Quantity × unit price differs from your payment. The payment you entered will be saved unchanged. Calculated amount:
fuel.nonLiquidHint: Gas and charging costs are recorded. A liquid-fuel km/l calculation does not apply here.
fuel.coverageHint: Only choose “All recorded” when every fuel purchase since the previous full tank is in this log. Missing purchases make that consumption cycle unusable.
fuel.invalidNumber: Enter a nonnegative value. Quantity must be greater than zero. Use up to two decimals for money and three for quantity or mileage; payment is required.
fuel.invalidTime: Enter a valid Cairo date and time and choose an occurrence if the clock time repeats.
fuel.retryChanged: The retry identity belongs to different inputs. Close this form and review the saved purchases before trying again.
fuel.referenceChanged: This purchase or a linked record is no longer available. Reload the list and review the latest records.
fuel.invalidRecord: Some purchase details are invalid. Review the date, amounts and selected records.
fuel.saveFailed: The purchase could not be confirmed. Your inputs remain here; check your connection and retry.
fuel.unconfirmed: The server may have saved this purchase. Retry with the same inputs to confirm the result without creating another purchase.

link.explanation: Already recorded this payment as an Other expense? Link that exact expense to count it once in net income.
link.searchHint: Shows matching amounts within seven days either side of this date, for this vehicle or without a vehicle. Existing active fuel or service links are excluded.
link.failed: Matching expenses could not load. Check your connection and retry.
link.empty: No matching available expenses in this date range.
link.deleteHint: The linked expense is a separate record and remains unchanged.

efficiency.title: Consumption evidence
efficiency.method: Full-to-full measurement for this vehicle within the selected month. Excludes the opening fill; includes partial fills up to a closing full tank, with all fills confirmed recorded.
efficiency.failed: Consumption evidence could not load. Retry to review it.
efficiency.tooMany: This period contains too many records to calculate safely. Use a shorter period.
efficiency.insufficient: There is not enough confirmed evidence to calculate consumption.

issue.NO_COMPLETED_CYCLE: No usable full-to-full cycle in this period.
issue.MIXED_VEHICLES: Readings from different vehicles cannot be combined.
issue.UNKNOWN_FUEL: Confirm the historical fuel kind before calculating.
issue.UNSUPPORTED_FUEL: Gas and charging quantities do not use this liquid-fuel method.
issue.MIXED_FUEL: Incompatible fuel types break a measurement cycle.
issue.MISSING_QUANTITY: A quantity is missing inside a cycle.
issue.MISSING_ODOMETER: A full-tank boundary lacks an odometer reading.
issue.ODOMETER_ORDER: An odometer reading goes backwards or shows no distance.
issue.AMBIGUOUS_TIME: Purchases share a timestamp, so their order is uncertain.
issue.UNCONFIRMED_FILLS: Not all fills have been confirmed recorded.
issue.INVALID_RECORD: Some records contain invalid measurement data.

recordDrafts.title: Entries saved on this device
recordDrafts.empty: Changes will be kept on this device.
recordDrafts.failed: Your latest changes are not saved on this device.
recordDrafts.privacy: Drafts stay in this browser until saved or discarded. Signing out removes them. Clearing browser data or private browsing can remove them too.
recordDrafts.pending: The save may already have reached your account. Retry to check it with the same details; do not enter it again.
recordDrafts.completed: Saved to your account. Retry to finish clearing the local draft.
recordDrafts.storage: This browser could not keep the draft. Keep this window open and retry device storage before saving.
recordDrafts.conflict: This draft changed in another window. This copy cannot overwrite it. Close this copy and reopen the saved draft to review it.
recordDrafts.account: Your account session changed. Sign in again to continue.
recordDrafts.invalid: This device draft cannot be read safely. Retry after updating the app, or check your account records before discarding this copy.
recordDrafts.confirmDiscard: Discard this unfinished entry from this device?
recordDrafts.confirmPendingDiscard: First check your saved entries: this save may have succeeded. Discarding removes only this device copy; it does not undo a saved entry.
recordDrafts.listFailed: Saved drafts could not be loaded. Retry before entering the same record again.
recordDrafts.noLongerPending: This device draft was completed or removed in another window. Check your saved records before starting another entry.
recordDrafts.confirmUnreadableDiscard: This draft cannot be read and may contain a pending save. Check your account records first. Discard only this unreadable device copy?

workSessions.title: Work time
workSessions.explanation: Record work time, including waiting between trips. End a session when you stop working and start a new one after a break. Overlapping trips and completed sessions count once in total hours.
workSessions.platformSession: Platform-attributed session — its existing attribution is retained.
workSessions.openGuidance: This session enters reports after you end it. Open sessions are not included in recorded hours.
workSessions.abandoned: This session has been open for more than seven days. Review the actual end time; an open session does not prove continuous work.
workSessions.timeGuidance: Review the actual times in Cairo time. A session can span midnight and last up to seven days. Future work cannot be recorded.
workSessions.invalidTime: Check the actual start and end times. End must follow start, within seven days, and neither time can be in the future. Choose an occurrence if Cairo repeats this time.
workSessions.statusConfirmation: Review this session before confirming. The change is recorded in its history and updates reported hours. Deleting an open session cancels it.
workSessions.historyGuidance: Changes show the recorded times and versions. Older records may have no history before this feature was introduced.
workSessions.historyEmpty: No retained changes for this session yet.
workSessions.loadFailed: Work sessions could not be loaded. Check your connection and retry before choosing an action.
workSessions.saveUnconfirmed: The save could not be confirmed. Your original times are kept on this device. Retry the saved request to find out whether it was applied.
workSessions.identityConflict: This saved request conflicts with another action. Review the current session before discarding or replacing the request.
workSessions.stateUnconfirmed: The current session could not be confirmed. You can keep a start request on this device, or end the last displayed session. The server checks its state when your saved request is retried.

wellness.title: Wellness
wellness.subtitle: Small, optional reminders and a checklist for your workday.
wellness.privacy: Saved only for your account in this browser. These settings and the last seven Cairo calendar days work offline. They do not sync to other devices or go to administrators. Signing out or clearing browser data removes them. No sleep, symptom, or medical assessment is stored.
wellness.safeStop: Use the screen only when safely stopped. Do not wait for an app reminder if you feel sleepy.
wellness.delivery: Reminders appear inside Ehsbha while it is open and visible. They resume when you return, one at a time, without a backlog of alerts. No browser notification permission is needed. They cannot wake a closed app or guarantee delivery in the background.
wellness.timerLimits: Enable a reminder first. This timer measures elapsed time since you start it, including gaps; it does not measure driving, sitting, sleep, or recorded work hours. It pauses automatically after 16 hours. Restart it for your next work period.
wellness.frequencyHint: All reminders start disabled. Choose your own frequency. Changing a frequency restarts that reminder’s countdown; it does not clear “skip today”.
wellness.quietHint: Quiet hours can cross midnight. Identical start and end hours pause reminders all day. Skip today resets at Cairo midnight.
wellness.storageError: Your wellness change could not be saved or loaded on this device. Keep this page open and retry. Check that browser storage is available; no save has been confirmed.
wellness.checklistHint: Record only what you choose. Unrecorded does not mean you did not do it. Dismissing a reminder never fills in this checklist.
wellness.weekHint: Your checklist entries in Cairo calendar days, including today. These counts are not a health score or proof of adequate rest.
wellness.resetHint: Clear this account’s checklist and reminder settings on this device, and pause reminders? This cannot be undone.
wellness.sourcesHint: General guidance, not a medical assessment. The break recommendation comes from UK guidance, not an Egyptian legal limit. Your selected timer is a preference, not proof that it is safe to continue driving.

sources.driving: UK Highway Code: tiredness and breaks
sources.movement: NHS: movement and reducing sedentary time

guidance.water: When safely stopped, consider drinking water. Fluid needs vary with heat, activity, and individual advice; this reminder does not set a fluid target.
guidance.break: Plan a safe place to rest. UK driving guidance recommends at least a 15-minute break after two hours of driving. A timer does not know how long you have driven.
guidance.move: When safely stopped, consider a short walk or comfortable movement to interrupt prolonged sitting.
guidance.hours: Your chosen elapsed-time reminder has arrived. Review your work plan and whether to finish or pause.
guidance.awareness: Notice how you feel. If sleepy, stop somewhere safe and rest. Recorded trips and gaps cannot show how much you slept or whether you are fit to drive.

wellness.deliveryShort: Appears only while Ehsbha is open and visible.

workScore.title: Work indicators
workScore.subtitle: A personal view of recorded business results.
workScore.meaning: Version 2 compares your results with your own previous recorded days. It does not assess driving safety, fatigue, sleep, or health. The overall indicator uses efficiency 7/15, profit 5/15, and work-time variation 3/15. These product weights are not an industry benchmark.
workScore.insufficient: At least three earlier recorded days within the previous 13 days, today’s data, distance, and non-zero financial baselines are needed. Missing data is not a zero score.
workScore.efficiencyHint: Compared with the median of earlier recorded days with distance. 50 means equal to your baseline; higher means more income per km.
workScore.profitHint: Compared with the median of earlier recorded days, including losses. 50 means equal to your baseline.
workScore.consistencyHint: Describes variation in recorded minutes on earlier days. It is not a recommendation to work fixed or longer hours; breaks and days off are appropriate.
workScore.historyHint: Latest 14 saved snapshots, oldest first. Version 1 included unsupported safety estimates and is excluded. Snapshots record the data available when generated and may differ after corrections.
workScore.noHistory: No snapshots for this version yet.
workScore.loadError: Today’s work indicators could not be loaded. Retry to read the recorded results.
workScore.historyError: Your work-indicator history could not be loaded. Retry to see saved snapshots.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Saved weekly and monthly views of your recorded work.
reports.date: Any date in the completed period
reports.createHelp: Choose a completed Monday–Sunday week or calendar month, using Cairo dates. If it already has a report, its latest saved version opens.
reports.reviseHelp: Capture the same period again using today’s corrected records. Earlier versions stay available. This requires the latest report version.
reports.invalid: Choose a valid date in a completed week or month.
reports.requestFailed: The report request was not confirmed. Your saved request is kept; reconnect and retry it.
reports.notFound: This report or version is unavailable for this account. Return to your reports and choose a saved report.
reports.archiveHelp: Reports are snapshots. Corrections to trips, costs, or work time appear after you save a new version. Previously opened reports may be available offline on this device.
reports.emptyHelp: Create a report for a completed period. Automatic reports appear when that period has recorded activity.
reports.loadFailed: The report list could not be refreshed. Any saved list shown may be older; reconnect and retry.
reports.moreFailed: More reports could not be loaded. Retry to continue.
reports.snapshotHelp: These are the records available when this version was saved. Missing records are not estimated. Amounts are Egyptian pounds.
reports.cached: This saved version is available, but the server could not be reached. Reconnect and retry before making changes.
reports.noActivity: No recorded financial or work activity was found for this period. This does not mean you did not work.
reports.cashBasis: Net operating income = trip income after platform deductions − recorded operating costs. Costs count once, including linked fuel, maintenance, toll and parking payments. This is recorded cash spending, not depreciation or an estimate of fuel consumed.
reports.ratiosHelp: Work time combines completed work sessions and trips without counting overlapping time twice. A missing time or distance denominator leaves the rate unavailable.
reports.grossCoverage: Gross income is recorded for {known} of {count} trips. The known subtotal is {amount}; it is not the total gross income.
reports.commissionCoverage: Commission is recorded for {known} of {count} trips. The known subtotal is {amount}; missing commission is not treated as zero.
reports.observedDays: Comparison across {count} days with recorded activity. Zero-activity days are excluded; tied days may share the same result.
reports.highestDay: Highest recorded daily net: {date}, {net}, from {count} trips.
reports.lowestDay: Lowest recorded daily net: {date}, {net}, from {count} trips. Costs can occur on a day without trips.
reports.netIncreased: Recorded net is {amount} higher than the previous period.
reports.netDecreased: Recorded net is {amount} lower than the previous period.
reports.reviewCosts: Review the largest recorded costs below to identify payments you want to check. Their timing can explain changes in net income.
reports.recordHours: Record completed work time to make the hourly income comparison available.
reports.trendHelp: Each row uses a Cairo date. These are recorded results, not a forecast.
reports.platformBasis: Platform contribution is trip income after platform deductions and trip tolls/parking. Fuel and other operating costs are excluded here. It is different from overall net income.
reports.groupLimit: This breakdown exceeds the supported 200 groups. The overall financial totals remain complete.
reports.vehicleBasis: Vehicle totals include only costs explicitly assigned to that vehicle. Unassigned costs remain separate.
reports.noVehicleCosts: No costs assigned to a vehicle in this period.
reports.linkedCosts: Fuel and maintenance record totals describe the purchases/services dated in this period. A linked expense counts once on its payment date, which may be in another period. Do not add these detail totals to operating costs.
reports.noCosts: No positive costs recorded in this period.
reports.historyFailed: Saved versions could not be loaded. Reconnect and retry.

wellness.title: Available wellness answers on this device
wellness.help: Separate from the saved financial report. Only the last seven Cairo dates are kept on this device; older or unrecorded answers are unavailable. Nothing here is uploaded or used to judge your health.
wellness.empty: No recorded wellness answers for this period are currently available on this device.
wellness.failed: Local wellness answers could not be read. Retry on this device.

settings.title: Automatic report delivery
settings.guidance: Create reports for the latest completed week and month when recorded activity exists. One inbox notice per period; older missed periods are not sent in bulk. Reports stay available in the app.
settings.loadFailed: Report delivery settings could not be loaded. Reconnect and retry.
settings.timeHelp: Choose delivery outside quiet hours. Delivery is checked every 15 minutes and can arrive later after a service interruption.
settings.invalid: Choose valid times with delivery outside quiet hours, or disable both automatic reports.
